about: R404A is a blend of R125, R143a and R134a used mainly in commercial low- and medium-temperature refrigeration such as cold rooms, display cabinets and refrigerated transport. It is non-flammable.
R404A is charged as a liquid because it is a blend. It has a high global warming potential, so use it for existing systems and avoid venting.

faq.question: Is R404A flammable?
faq.answer: R404A is classified as non-flammable, but it is stored under pressure and can displace oxygen in enclosed spaces. Handle it through a trained technician with proper gauges, recovery equipment and ventilation.
